t: What Gearbox Performance Database Is All About
title: What Gearbox Performance Database Is All About
description: Gearbox performance is ratio × efficiency × durability: helical gears run quiet (95-98% per stage), worm gears self-lock but waste (50-90%), planetary packs ratio densely. AGMA ratings govern bending and pitting; lubrication (splash vs pressure) decides life. Noise is a quality metric — gear whine means imperfect conjugacy. The comparison: ratio needed, efficiency wanted, noise allowed. This database is the complete gearbox record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
